request.task: T4A1 exact closure: Fable R-01 and R-03 component accessibility state
request.head: 899b39433c4be242b4b3adcd39f3e6cd53df99c0

findings.scenario: Allowlisted tests never render rosterState.kind==="error" (with or without retrying/focusAfterRetry), never click Try again, and cannot run Content's focus effect because they use renderToStaticMarkup. The cited e2e oracle only records held-retry + duplicate GET + success focusing the first radio. Input: retry GET fails again. Required behavior (focus the still-mounted Try again control) has no unit or cited live oracle, so R-03 can regress while the suite stays green.
findings.remediation: Add DOM tests (not only static markup) that start from roster error, activate Try again twice before the GET resolves (one GET, aria-disabled not native disabled, status announced, button still focused/mounted), then assert focus on the first radio after ready and on the retry control after a second error. Keep a static-markup case for error+retrying so aria-disabled/status/button presence cannot drift.

findings.scenario: On successful retry the focused Try again node unmounts as kind flips to ready; focus restore runs in useEffect (after paint), not useLayoutEffect. Input: Try again focused → GET succeeds. Wrong behavior: browser moves focus to body for a paint, then the effect focuses the first radio. Screen readers can announce the document; a focus race exists on the required success path. focusAfterRetry is also never cleared, so any later rosterState identity change with the flag still true re-steals focus.
findings.remediation: Restore focus in useLayoutEffect (before paint) on the ready/error transition, then clear focusAfterRetry in the same turn (one-shot ref or setState) so the effect cannot refocus on unrelated renders.

findings.scenario: Retry status is a role="status" live region nested inside the roster role="alert". Input: error surface, activate Try again. Wrong behavior: nested live regions are ignored or collapsed by common AT, so "Trying the local roster again…" may never be announced as its own status; the assertive alert may instead re-read the old error plus the button. That undercuts R-03's announce-retry-status requirement.
findings.remediation: Keep the Try again button mounted in the alert, but render the retry status as a sibling live region outside the alert (or replace the alert contents with a single non-nested status while retrying).

findings.scenario: createProposal returns silently on !task.trim() and the submit button is disabled when trim is empty, so the panel never commits {kind:"error", origin:"task"}. The only task-origin aria-invalid check injects that state into LocalAiTeammatePanelContent and does not assert aria-describedby. Residual mismatches in submitAiTeammateAssignment tests use toMatchObject({kind:"error"}) and would still pass without origin.
findings.remediation: Either produce origin:"task" through the real submit path and assert textarea aria-invalid plus describedby, or add a submitAiTeammateAssignment("") test that requires origin:"task" and make every error assertion include origin.

audit.proof_assessment: R-01 markup is implemented (error.origin required; aria-invalid only for origin==="task"; assignment error id stays on textarea aria-describedby) and the request-origin static test matches that. R-03's mounted aria-disabled retry, sync ref-before-GET, generation/mounted commit guards, and success focus are present in code, but the allowlisted suite does not exercise those states; the execution receipt's R-03 oracle omits failed-retry refocus; the accessibility aggregate is recorded as timed out, not a pass. Proof is therefore incomplete for exact R-03 closure.
residual_risks: Strict Mode still issues two initial roster GETs; only generation/mounted checks drop the stale completion (retry is ref-gated, initial load is not).
Hung fetch leaves error+retrying with aria-disabled Try again indefinitely (no abort/timeout).
Empty parsed roster: ready+focusAfterRetry with no radio; firstRosterRadioRef.focus() is a silent no-op after the retry button unmounts.
Working assignment submit is natively enabled (disabled={!canSubmit && !isWorking}) and relies on canSubmit/submitting.current to prevent a second POST.
AiTeammateRosterState optional retrying/focusAfterRetry flags allow overlapping combinations instead of a discriminated retrying kind.
